summary: Bonnie is a member of the Organization and, along with Celina, she is a minion of Dr. Rickman.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Bonnie attacked [[Lok Lambert]] and [[Sophie Casterwill]] while they were looking for books about the lost city of [[Ys]]. Bonnie, who disguised herself as a bookseller, began to throw knives at the duo. Joined by [[Celina]], a chase ensued which lead to a confrontation in which Lok and Sophie were overpowered by the duo. However Bonnie and Celina were forced to retreat when [[Dante Vale]] arrived. Bonnie and Celina reported back to an enraged [[Dr. Rickman]]. Later the pair arrived at the city of [[Ys]] with Rickman and [[Captain Caine]] and surrounded the Huntik team. {{Source|The Seekers of Ys}}

Bonnie then attacked Dante, summoning [[Geisha]] alongside Celina's [[Red Vampress]]. However they were eventually defeated when [[Zhalia Moon]] arrived and the pair were arrested by the [[Huntik Foundation]] along with [[Dr. Rickman]], [[Gregor]] and [[Ford]]. {{source|The Lost City of Casterwill}}
